_comment: AJC-64 item 0e (M5-R47) — the regulatory_sections corroborant snapshots.
These are the ACTUAL rows from the wc-knowledge-base Postgres
regulatory_sections table (Prisma model RegulatorySection), not a copy of
the leginfo artifacts they are compared against. That independence is the
entire evidentiary value: a corroborant derived from the pinned source
would make the cross-check a self-comparison, which is the defect this
The row is a CORROBORANT ONLY and never the pinned source — it carries no
hash-pinned provenance chain of its own upstream, which is why leginfo
remains the pinned authority and this is the second opinion.
query: SELECT section_number, source_type, full_text, last_amended, source_url FROM regulatory_sections WHERE section_number IN ('4663','4664')
known_formatting_difference: The database row prefixes its section heading with a section sigil:
'§4663.' where the leginfo artifact reads '4663.'. That is the ONLY
difference between the two sources after canonicalization — the remaining
1799 (4663) and 1467 (4664) characters are identical, including the
It is handled by strip_section_heading(), a narrow declared normalization
of the leading heading token only, NOT by widening canonicalize_statute_text.
A section sigil anywhere else in the body is left untouched and is probed.
